# Warm-up
install.packages("beepr")
beepr::beep(0)

for (i in 1:11) {
  beepr::beep(i)
  Sys.sleep(2)
}

print("Done!")

# Part 1
set.seed(648)
urn_prob <- function(nreps = 100000, b1 = 10, y1 = 8, b2 = 6, y2 = 6) {
  i <- rbinom(nreps, 1, b1/(b1+y1))
  result <- mean((i+b2)/(i+b2+y2))
  return(result)
}

urn_prob()
